mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT evaluatee_id) FROM evaluator_mappings_51 WHERE period_id = #{periodId} AND is_deleted = 'n'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM final_grades_51 WHERE period_id = #{periodId} AND is_deleted = 'n'
SELECT final_grade_code as grade_code, COUNT(*) as count FROM final_grades_51 WHERE period_id = #{periodId} AND is_deleted = 'n' GROUP BY final_grade_code ORDER BY final_grade_code ASC

SELECT d.dept_name as dept_name, ROUND(AVG(fg.total_score), 2) as avg_score FROM final_grades_51 fg JOIN employees_51 e ON fg.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN departments_51 d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE fg.period_id = #{periodId} AND fg.is_deleted = 'n' GROUP BY d.dept_name ORDER BY avg_score DESC

SELECT TOP (#{limit}) e.name as evaluatee_name, d.dept_name as dept_name, '최종 확정' as activity_type, fg.created_at as activity_time FROM final_grades_51 fg JOIN employees_51 e ON fg.emp_id = e.emp_id JOIN departments_51 d ON e.dept_id = d.dept_id WHERE fg.period_id = #{periodId} AND fg.is_deleted = 'n' ORDER BY fg.created_at DESC
